title: UNIPLASTICS.COM
description: Universal Plastics Inc. is a family-owned commercial specialty subcontractor with over 50 years of experience, specializing in custom wall panel systems, wall protection, and high-impact wall coverings. They serve a diverse clientele, including commercial projects such as airports and medical facilities, providing innovative solutions with materials like FRP, stainless steel, and plastic laminates. As a master distributor for Marlite in Northern California, they also offer a wide range of products including solid surfaces and decorative wall panels. Their commitment to quality and customer service makes them a leader in the industry.
